title: Container ensure-guard needs a claude auth-preflight before dispatching workers in container mode
description: runContainerEnsureGuard / ensureWorkerContainer (src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts; src/commands/sidecar.ts:3331-3368) re-asserts firewall, config, and toolchain on every ensure but NOT claude auth. A worker_isolation=container sidecar can therefore dispatch an implementer/reviewer/planner worker (docker exec -it cam-worker claude ...) into a container where claude is unauthenticated; the worker fails at runtime instead of a clean fail-closed preflight -- a silent wedge that undermines CAM-139 (autonomous meta-loop requires trustworthy container mode). Discovered live during the CAM-175 ceremony 2026-07-22: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN was commented out in .env, so `docker exec cam-worker claude auth status --json` returned loggedIn:false/authMethod:none; after setting the token and recreating the container it returned loggedIn:true/authMethod:oauth_token. Fix: add an auth-preflight to the container ensure path that runs `docker exec cam-worker claude auth status --json`, parses loggedIn (the codebase's own auth-probe convention, src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts:72-73), and on loggedIn:false fails closed -- write a durable stall marker mirroring the FirewallError path (.claude/.cam-sidecar-stalled.json, reason container-auth-unavailable) and abort so no worker dispatches, matching the FirewallError/ContainerConfigError/ToolchainMismatchError fail-closed handling at sidecar.ts:3344-3368.
